column1: # comment: "Dublin Core maximal alignment. DCMI Terms properties and DCMI Type classes mapped to GMEOW canonical terms. dc: element alignments are derived via the dumb-down principle (dcterms:X rdfs:subPropertyOf dc:X), not hand-authored here."

column6: comment
A GMEOW Collection is a DCMI Collection
A GMEOW Dataset is a DCMI Dataset
A GMEOW Document (abstract intellectual work of textual content) is a DCMI Text
A GMEOW Event is a DCMI Event
GMEOW MediaObject covers image, audio, and video; DCMI Image is one possible specialization
GMEOW MediaObject covers image, audio, and video; DCMI MovingImage is one possible specialization
GMEOW MediaObject covers image, audio, and video; DCMI Sound is one possible specialization
A GMEOW PhysicalObject is a DCMI PhysicalObject
A GMEOW Service is a DCMI Service
A GMEOW SoftwareProject is a DCMI Software
A GMEOW WebPage is a DCMI InteractiveResource
DCTerms abstract — a summary of the content of a creative work
DCTerms audience — the intended audience of a creative work
DCTerms bibliographicCitation — a bibliographic reference for a creative work
DCTerms conformsTo — an established standard to which the described resource conforms
DCTerms dateAccepted — the date a creative work was accepted
DCTerms available — the date a creative work became or will become available
DCTerms created — the creation date of a creative work
DCTerms modified — the last modification date of a creative work (distinct from sourceModifiedAt which is source-specific)
DCTerms dateSubmitted — the date a creative work was submitted
DCTerms extent — the size or duration of a creative work
DCTerms format — the file format, physical medium, or dimensions of the resource. GMEOW hasManifestationFormat covers the physical/digital carrier aspect; extent covers the size/duration aspect.
DCTerms title — GMEOW's reified CreativeWorkTitle downcasts to dcterms:title by projection
DCTerms hasVersion — a related resource that is a version of the described resource
DCTerms isReferencedBy — a related resource that references the described resource
DCTerms isRequiredBy — a related resource that requires the described resource
DCTerms medium — the material or physical carrier of a creative work
DCTerms provenance — a statement of changes in ownership and custody
DCTerms references — a related resource that is referenced by the described resource. GMEOW references is general (formerly message-scoped, now Entity-scoped).
DCTerms requires — a related resource that is required by the described resource
DCTerms spatial — the spatial extent or scope of a creative work
DCTerms isReplacedBy — a related resource that supersedes the described resource
DCTerms replaces — a related resource that is superseded by the described resource
DCTerms tableOfContents — a list of subunits of a creative work
DCTerms temporal — the temporal extent or scope of a creative work
DCTerms isVersionOf — a related resource of which the described resource is a version
